programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Don't Push It
programmes.d: Three emergency deliveries in the ER cause a turf war with the labor and delivery department; two gunshot victims have a surprising connection; an unidentified jogger goes into a coma and the ER staff becomes detectives trying to find the woman's family.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Deadly Sore Throat
programmes.d: A wheezing woman comes to the ER with a difficult-to-diagnose breathing problem, and a very angry husband! A grown man suddenly begins acting bizarrely like a child; is his medication helping him, or making him worse?!?
Genetic genealogy provides the key that enables police to unlock the mystery of a woman's seemingly random murder 40 years after her death.
The unsolved, 20-year-old murder of an unidentified woman in Utah finally gets closer to being closed with the confession of a known serial killer and some advances in DNA technology.
Sarah Williams and Katrina Walsh: the story of two friends who carried out the evil, jealousy-fuelled murder of Sadie Hartley.
Bobby Joe Long is an American serial killer and rapist who terrorised the Tampa Bay Area in Florida during 1984. During his eight-month sadistic killing spree, he murdered ten women.
Newlyweds Brandon and Brandy Wiley are on a backpacking adventure in Costa Rica.

In June 2003, Blake Stanfield and his aged dad Neil go kayaking in the Alaskan wilderness. Everything goes fine until they run into some ice on the river, and they soon find themselves swept underneath.
In 2003, David Hunt and his daughter Leia, set off on a snowmobiling adventure in the Quebec backcountry.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Code Grenn In The ER
programmes.d: Doctors perform a chest incision while awaiting surgeons; an iguana is brought in following a car accident.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: No Time To Think
programmes.d: A circus performer is bitten by a poisonous snake, a baby is delivered in a car park and Dr. Rob gets covered in blood by a man who is HIV-positive.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Twists & Turns
programmes.d: A violent convict may be faking paralysis as part of a prison escape plan; a young man seems to be suffocating for no apparent reason; a father is stabbed in the heart trying to protect his son; a college cheerleader mysteriously goes into cardiac arrest.
A look at a murdered brunette who was left inside a burned-out car in the high desert.
